output.objection: You are still leaving a human in the loop to schedule the retraining, which defeats the purpose of cutting operational overhead. I need the trigger to fire the moment the alert lands so we stop paying for idle cycles.
output.correction: I did not ask for a full unmonitored pipeline, I asked for the scheduling step to be removed from the manual queue. You are confusing my request for speed with a demand to drop all governance controls.
